Thick, coarse, copper-orange hair styled in a short, rugged crop with a thick, groomed beard. Small, piercing amber eyes with a confident, mischievous expression. Apparent age in the late 30s with a mature, weathered face. A massive, hulking muscular build. Wears a heavy Norse warrior ensemble consisting of a brown leather tunic, fur-lined pauldrons, and bronze metallic bracers. Signature details include a thick leather belt and traditional Aesir armor plating.
BODY COLOR: pale tan
